title: Stihl FS 56 RC String Trimmer - Repair & Troubleshooting Manual
warnings: Always disconnect the spark plug wire before servicing.
Do not smoke or use open flames near fuel system.
Allow engine to cool completely before touching exhaust or cylinder.
Wear safety glasses when working with springs and clips.
Never run the engine without the air filter installed.
inspection_prompts_for_agent: Can you see the air filter cover on the side of the engine?
Is the primer bulb cracked or discolored?
Can you read the model number on the data plate?
Does the starter rope pull freely or feel stuck?
Is there visible fuel in the primer bulb when you press it?

external_anatomy.top: Handle with throttle trigger and safety lock

disassembly_steps.action: Remove air filter cover (2 screws or clips)
Remove air filter element and inspect
disassembly_steps.note: Replace if torn or heavily soiled
Watch for the rope pulley spring

disassembly_steps.action: Access carburetor by removing the air filter base plate

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check fuel and primer
troubleshooting_steps.action: Ensure fresh fuel mix (50:1). Press primer bulb 5-6 times until fuel is visible.
troubleshooting_steps.condition: If primer doesn't fill, suspect fuel line or tank vent.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check spark plug
troubleshooting_steps.action: Remove spark plug with wrench. Inspect for carbon buildup, correct gap (0.020 in). Replace if electrode is worn.
troubleshooting_steps.condition: If no spark, check ignition module.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check air filter
troubleshooting_steps.action: Remove air filter cover. Inspect filter element. Clean or replace if dirty.
troubleshooting_steps.condition: A clogged filter causes rich running and bogging.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check fuel filter and lines
troubleshooting_steps.action: Pull fuel filter from inside tank using a hooked wire. Inspect lines for cracks.
troubleshooting_steps.condition: Hardened or cracked lines cause air leaks and starting issues.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check carburetor
troubleshooting_steps.action: If previous steps don't resolve, the carburetor may need cleaning or rebuild. Remove and disassemble carefully.
troubleshooting_steps.condition: Common after long storage with old fuel.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check exhaust/muffler screen
troubleshooting_steps.action: Remove muffler. Check spark arrestor screen for carbon buildup. Clean with wire brush.
troubleshooting_steps.condition: Blocked screen causes power loss and overheating.

stop_conditions: Cracked cylinder or piston scoring visible
follow_up_questions: Have you changed the fuel recently?
Does it start briefly then die, or not start at all?
Any unusual sounds when pulling the starter?
hidden_fasteners: Air filter cover has hidden clip at bottom
Muffler has one hidden screw under the heat shield

common_failures.fix: Drain old fuel, clean carb, fresh 50:1 mix

common_failures.likely_cause: Fuel delivery — clogged filter or cracked fuel line
Clogged air filter or exhaust screen
common_failures.fix: Clean/replace air filter, clean spark arrestor

notes: The FS 56 RC uses the Easy2Start system. Always use Stihl 2-cycle oil or equivalent at 50:1 ratio.
